name: Cotton
read: Cotton Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 82.39, 86 days to expiry 2027-02-05): at-the-money implied vol 23.2%, -0.9 pts vs 2026-11-05. 20-day realized vol 11.8%, so options trade at a premium of 11.4 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +3.6 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-10-29 to 2026-11-11) call open interest rose 13,238 and puts fell 719; put/call OI 0.53 → 0.5, front futures 78.5 → 82.39. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +1,596 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 21.1% → 20.1%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 85 calls (7,524 lots) and 80 puts (3,059). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 85 calls +1,404; Mar 27 90 calls +1,059. Biggest cut: Dec 27 80 calls -1,277.
